67700.meaning1: aggregate of consciousness; mass of awareness; fifth of the five aggregates

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

67701.meaning1: related to consciousness; concerning awareness; connected with sentience; kind of consciousness

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

67703.commentary: (VISM) viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti ettha pana n'āssa anto'ti anantaṃ. anantam'eva ānañcaṃ. viññāṇaṃ ānañcaṃ viññāṇ'ānañcan'ti avatvā viññāṇ'añcan'ti vuttaṃ. ayañ'h'ettha rūḷhīsaddo. taṃ viññāṇ'añcaṃ adhiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena āyatanamassa sasampayuttadhammassa jhānassa devānaṃ dev'āyatanam'ivā'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ.

examples.text: nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ neyyan'ti.
idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

67704.meaning1: state of the dimension of infinite consciousness; element of the dimension of infinite consciousness
67704.commentary: (SNa) rūpaṃ paṭiccā'ti rūp'āvacarasamāpattiṃ paṭicca. rūp'āvacarasamāpattiyā hi sati ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpatti nāma hoti rūpasamatikkamo vā, tasmā evam'āha. viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātuādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

67705.meaning1: dependent on the dimension of infinite consciousness; based on the dimension of infinite consciousness

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

67706.meaningLit: discourse on the question about the dimension of infinite consciousness

67707.meaning1: having the dimension of infinite consciousness as peak; with the dimension of infinite consciousness as apex
67707.commentary: (SNa) muditāvihārissa pana tena tena pāmojjakāraṇena uppannapāmojjasattānaṃ viññāṇaṃ samanupassantassa muditāya pavattisambhavato viññāṇaggahaṇaparicitaṃ hoti, ath'assa anukkam'ādhigataṃ ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ atikkamma ākāsanimittagocare viññāṇe cittaṃ upasaṃharato appakasiren'eva tattha cittaṃ pakkhandati. iti muditā viññāṇ'añc'āyatanassa upanissayo hoti, na tato paraṃ, tasmā viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaparamā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: sabbaso vā pana ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, muditācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.

67708.meaning1: recognition of dimension of infinite consciousness; perception of dimension of infinite consciousness (in)

examples.text: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti

67709.meaning1: aware of the dimension of infinite consciousness; percipient of the dimension of infinite consciousness (in)
67709.commentary: (ADha) viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-saññā-sahagatan'ti, ettha pana anantan'ti manasikātabbavasena n'āssa anto'ti anantaṃ. anantam'eva ānañcaṃ. viññāṇaṃ ānañcaṃ viññāṇ'ānañcan'ti avatvā viññāṇ'añcan'ti vuttaṃ. ayañ'h'ettha rūḷhīsaddo.

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… na ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññī assa, na viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññī assa

67710.meaning1: attainment of the dimension of infinite consciousness

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino'ti. so tāya viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayam'pi kho viññāṇañc'āyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

67711.meaning1: associated with the dimension of infinite consciousness; connected with the base of infinity of consciousness

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato viññāṇ'añc'āyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

67712.meaning1: refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
67712.meaning2: refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness

examples.text: tassa yā purimā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

67713.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness
67713.meaning2: with refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite consciousness

examples.text: tassa yā purimā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

67714.meaningLit: discourse on the dimension of infinite consciousness

67715.meaning1: gone to the dimension of infinite consciousness; epithet of a class of devas

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā viññāṇ'añc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā viññāṇ'añc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

67716.meaning1: station of consciousness; plane of awareness
67716.commentary: (DN 33) catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo. rūp'ūpāyaṃ… vedan'ūpāyaṃ… saññ'ūpāyaṃ… saṅkhār'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.

examples.text: viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo sabbā, abhijānaṃ tathāgato, tiṭṭhantam'enaṃ jānāti, vimuttaṃ tapparāyaṇaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātu, evaṃ catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo daṭṭhabbā. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āpodhātu, evaṃ nandirāgo daṭṭhabbo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni, evaṃ viññāṇaṃ sāhāraṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

67717.commentary: (SNa) yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati

examples.text: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti
evam'eva kho, bho gotama… saṅkhār'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo saṅkhāresu patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati, viññāṇ'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo viññāṇe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavatī'ti.
cha'y'imā, āvuso, dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katamā cha? pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu
pathavīdhātū'ti patiṭṭhānadhātu. āpodhātū'ti ābandhanadhātu. tejodhātū'ti paripācanadhātu. vāyodhātū'ti vitthambhanadhātu. ākāsadhātū'ti asamphuṭṭhadhātu viññāṇadhātū'ti vijānanadhātu.

67721.meaning1: dependent on the mind; supported by consciousness; based on mentality

examples.text: viññāṇadhātuṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, na attato upagacchiṃ, na ca viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ.
ye ca viññāṇadhātunissitā upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

67723.meaning1: ending of awareness; cessation of consciousness

examples.text: tāsaṃ ce, āvuso, naḷakalāpīnaṃ ekaṃ ākaḍḍheyya, ekā papateyya, aparaṃ ce ākaḍḍheyya, aparā papateyya. evam'eva kho, āvuso, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho
nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.

67724.meaning1: path of practice leading to the cessation of consciousness

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

67725.meaning1: leading to the cessation of consciousness

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako viññāṇañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

67727.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of viññāṇapaccaya
67727.meaning1: dependent on consciousness; due to consciousness

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ viññāṇapaccayā, viññāṇ'ūpasamā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
avijjāpaccayā, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā

67728.meaning1: produced by consciousness; generated by conscious awareness

examples.text: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

67731.meaning1: imprisoned by consciousness; held captive by felt awareness
67731.meaningLit: bound with the bond of consciousness

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano viññāṇabandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

67732.meaning1: class of consciousness; type of awareness

examples.text: ajjhattikañc'eva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n'eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.

67733.meaning1: taking pleasure in consciousness; delighting in awareness

examples.text: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

67734.meaning1: freed by the exhaustion of consciousness; liberated through the dissolution of awareness

examples.text: viññāṇasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

67735.meaning1: free from classification in terms of consciousness

examples.text: yena viññāṇe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ viññāṇaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tāl'āvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ. viññāṇasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

67736.meaning1: source of consciousness; arising of consciousness

examples.text: nāmarūpasamudayā viññāṇasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā viññāṇanirodho.
viññāṇasamudayā nāmarūpasamudayo, viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo nāmarūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā

67737.meaning1: with consciousness as source; originating from awareness
67737.commentary: (MNa) viññāṇasamudayā'ti ettha pana yaṃ viññāṇaṃ yassa nāmassa yassa ca rūpassa yassa ca nāmarūpassa paccayo hoti, tassa vasena visuddhimagge paṭiccasamuppādaniddese vuttanayen'eva viññāṇasamudayā nāmarūpasamudayo veditabbo.

examples.text: nāmarūpañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ? nāmarūpaṃ viññāṇanidānaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ viññāṇajātikaṃ viññāṇapabhavaṃ.

67738.meaning1: happy with consciousness; pleased with awareness

examples.text: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

67739.meaning1: accompanied by consciousness; sentient; filled with awareness

examples.text: evam'eva kho, rājañña, yadā'yaṃ kāyo āyusahagato ca hoti usmāsahagato ca viññāṇasahagato ca, tadā lahutaro ca hoti mudutaro ca kammaññataro ca.

67745.meaning1: stream of consciousness; flow of awareness

examples.text: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati. purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti, ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke patiṭṭhitañca paraloke patiṭṭhitañ'ca. ayaṃ tatiyā dassanasamāpatti.

67746.commentary: (PM) kathaṃ viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati? idh'ekacco rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho me attā. so kho pana me ayaṃ attā iminā viññāṇena viññāṇavā'ti. viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati. seyyathā'pi rukkho chāyāsampanno assa. tam'enaṃ puriso evaṃ vadeyya, ayaṃ rukkho, ayaṃ chāyā. añño rukkho, aññā chāyā. so kho pan'āyaṃ rukkho imāya chāyāya chāyāvā'ti. chāyāvantaṃ rukkhaṃ samanupassati. evam'evaṃ idh'ekacco rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre attato samanupassati. tassa evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho me attā. so kho pana me ayaṃ attā iminā viññāṇena viññāṇavā'ti. viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati.

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ viññāṇaṃ, mama viññāṇan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā. evaṃ kho, gahapati, āturakāyo c'eva hoti āturacitto ca.

67748.meaning1: produced by rolling around after the change of consciousness

examples.text: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

67749.meaning1: born from rolling around after the change of consciousness

examples.text: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.

67750.meaning1: rolling around after the change of consciousness

examples.text: tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa viññāṇavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

67751.meaning1: (abhi) sequence of conscious events; series of consciousness

examples.text: me sutan'ti ettha mayā-sadd'attho me-saddo, sotadvāraviññāṇ'attho sutasaddo. tasmā evaṃ me sutan'ti evaṃ mayā sotaviññāṇapubbaṅ'gamāya viññāṇavīthiyā upadhāritan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

67753.meaning1: fact of impermanence of consciousness; fact of instability of awareness

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, viññāṇ'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. viññāṇaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto, viññāṇ'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto viññāṇasmiṃ nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

67754.meaningLit: discourse on not making consciousness evident
67754.sanskrit: vijñāna + na + prātyakṣa + karman + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

67755.meaning1: field of consciousness; dimension of knowing
67755.commentary: (SNa) mama cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. manodvāre pana mano'ti sāvajjanakaṃ bhav'aṅgacittaṃ.

examples.text: kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasi? mam'eva, samaṇa, sotaṃ, mama saddā … mam'eva, samaṇa, ghānaṃ, mama gandhā, mam'eva, samaṇa, jivhā, mama rasā, mam'eva, samaṇa, kāyo, mama phoṭṭhabbā, mam'eva, samaṇa, mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassaviññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasī'ti?

67756.meaning1: enjoying consciousness; taking pleasure in awareness

examples.text: saññ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso … saṅkhār'ārāmassa kho āvuso … viññāṇ'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti … n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

67757.meaning1: sustenance of consciousness; fuel of consciousness

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā moḷiyaphagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ko nu kho, bhante, viññāṇ'āhāraṃ āhāretī'ti? no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.

67758.meaning1: accumulation of consciousness that is clung to; aggregate of awareness that is grasped

examples.text: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannaṃ… yaṃ dūre santike vā sāsavaṃ upādāniyaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, pañc'upādānakkhandhā'ti.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

67760.meaning1: accumulation of consciousness that is clung to; aggregate of awareness that is grasped

examples.text: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

67761.synonym: aññāta, anubodha, abhiññāta, upaññāta, jānita, ñāta, vidita

examples.text: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
yo koci sutaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me sutan'ti, n'atthi tato doso. yo koci mutaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me mutan'ti, n'atthi tato doso. yo koci viññātaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me viññātan'ti, n'atthi tato doso'ti.

67762.meaning1: what is known; which one is conscious of; what is perceived

examples.text: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
yo koci sutaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me sutan'ti, n'atthi tato doso. yo koci mutaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me mutan'ti, n'atthi tato doso. yo koci viññātaṃ bhāsati, evaṃ me viññātan'ti, n'atthi tato doso'ti.

67763.meaning1: knowable; could be known; could be understood

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… viññatvā viññātabbaṃ, viññātaṃ na maññati, aviññātaṃ na maññati, viññātabbaṃ na maññati, viññātāraṃ na maññati.
ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.

67764.meaning1: merely the known; only what one is conscious of; knowing itself
67764.commentary: (SNa) viññāte viññātamattan'ti ettha pana viññātaṃ nāma manodvār'āvajjanena viññāt'ārammaṇaṃ, tasmiṃ viññāte viññātamattan'ti āvajjanapamāṇaṃ. yathā āvajjanena na rajjati na dussati na muyhati, evaṃ rajjan'ādivasena uppajjituṃ adatvā āvajjanapamāṇeneva cittaṃ ṭhapessāmī'ti ayam'ettha attho. (NIDD1a) viññāte viññātamatto'ti manoviññāṇena ñāte ñātamatto.

examples.text: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.

67765.meaning1: knower; who is conscious; conscious agent

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… viññatvā viññātabbaṃ, viññātaṃ na maññati, aviññātaṃ na maññati, viññātabbaṃ na maññati, viññātāraṃ na maññati.
tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā

67766.meaning1: who has understood the teaching; who has got the message
67766.commentary: (VINa) viññātaṃ sikkhattayasāsanaṃ etāyā'ti viññātasāsanā. (ANa) sikkhāttayasāsanaṃ etena viññātan'ti viññātasāsano.

examples.text: saddheyyavacasā nāma āgataphalā abhisametāvinī viññātasāsanā.
yo so, bhante, ariyasāvako āgataphalo viññātasāsano, so katamena vihārena bahulaṃ viharatī'ti?

67767.meaning1: who speaks about the known; who states what one has known (as)

examples.text: diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā, ime kho, āvuso, cattāro vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā.

aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.

67768.meaning1: who speaks about the known; who states what one has known (as)

examples.text: adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādīhoti.

67769.meaning1: to know; to understand; to comprehend
67769.commentary: (UDa) bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun'ti maggaphaladhammaṃ adhigantuṃ samattho, upanissayasampanno'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sabbāvantaṃ parisaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manas'ākāsi ko nu kho idha bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun'ti? addasā kho bhagavā suppabuddhaṃ kuṭṭhiṃ tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinnaṃ.

67770.commentary: (MNa) thero pana tāni dasa kathāvatthūni viññāpetī'ti viññāpako.

examples.text: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… ovādako viññāpako sandassako samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnan'ti?
upamā kho my'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayaṃ c'ev'ettha attho, samatittiko telapatto'ti kho, bhikkhave, kāyagatāya etaṃ satiyā adhivacanaṃ.

67772.commentary: (DNa) atthassa viññāpaniyā'ti ādimajjhapariyosānaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā bhāsit'atthassa viññāpanasamatthāya.

examples.text: akakkasaṃ viññāpaniṃ, giraṃ saccam'udīraye, yāya n'ābhisaje kañci, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti… poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya

67773.meaning1: sake of instructing; purpose of communicating
67773.commentary: (MNa) idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, paresaṃ viññāpanam'eva tathāgatassa dhammadesanāya payojanaṃ, tasmā na ekass'eva deseti, yattakā viññātāro atthi, sabbesaṃ desetī'ti.

examples.text: na kho pan'etaṃ, aggivessana, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yāva'd'eva viññāpan'atthāya tathāgato paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.

67775.grammar: adj, in comps, from viññāpana, caus
67775.construction:
vi + ñāpe + ana + ika
viññāpana + ika

67776.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of viññāpana, caus (+gen)
67776.meaning2: expressive; instructive (of); informative; enlightning; lit. causing to know
67776.construction:
vi + ñāpe + ana + ī
viññāpana + ī

examples.text: akakkasaṃ viññāpaniṃ, giraṃ saccaṃ udīraye, yāya nābhisajje kiñci, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

67778.commentary: (MNa) ye kathitakāraṇaṃ sallakkhenti, sukhena sakkā honti viññāpetuṃ, te suviññāpayā.

examples.text: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparaj'akkhe mahāraj'akkhe, tikkh'indriye mud'indriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app'ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, app'ekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.

67779.synonym: anusāsita, anusiṭṭha, ovadita, desita, saññatta, sandassita, sikkhāpita

examples.text: dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito. viññāpit'atthā c'amha saddhamme, kevalañ'ca no paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.

67780.meaning1: informed of the meaning; instructed in the sense

examples.text: dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito. viññāpit'atthā c'amha saddhamme, kevalañ'ca no paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ. atha no satthuno antaradhānaṃ hotī'ti.

67781.meaning1: should be asked for; should be requested

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, patto viññāpetabbo. yo viññāpeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.

67782.commentary: (MNa) n'atthi hantā vā'ti hantuṃ vā ghātetuṃ vā sotuṃ vā sāvetuṃ vā jānituṃ vā jānāpetuṃ vā samattho nāma n'atthī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: tattha n'atthi hantā vā ghātetā vā sotā vā sāvetā vā viññātā vā viññāpetā vā
yathāparisaṃ kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sarena viññāpeti, na c'assa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati.

yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
tato ce uttari sādiyeyyā'ti tat'uttari viññāpeti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ. paṭilābhena nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
seyyathā'pi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasiren'eva catuddisā viññāpeyya, evam'eva kho evaṃ bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.
yathāparisaṃ kho pana, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro sarena viññāpeti, na c'assa bahiddhā parisāya ghoso niccharati.

67786.meaning2: to ask; to request; to beg (for)

67787.meaning1: having asked; having requested; having begged (for)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

67788.meaning2: having informed, having taught, having intimated

examples.text: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, daḷhaṃ sikkhatha santiyā, mā vo pamatte viññāya, maccurājā amohayittha vas'ānuge.
puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjati manāpaṃ, uppajjati amanāpaṃ, uppajjati manāp'āmanāpaṃ
kassa pan'etaṃ sahassan'ti? hayavāhanan'ti anantaraṃ vuccamānattā hayānan'ti ayam'attho viññāyat'eva. hayā vāhanaṃ etassā'ti hayavāhanaṃ.

67795.meaning1: will comprehend; will understand; will recognize; will distinguish

examples.text: atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī, upamā viññūhi desitā, viññissanti mahānāgā, nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ.

67796.meaning1: blamed by the wise; criticized by intelligent people

examples.text: yadā tumhe, kālāmā, attanā'va jāneyyātha, ime dhammā akusalā, ime dhammā sāvajjā, ime dhammā viññugarahitā, ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantī'ti, atha tumhe, kālāmā, pajaheyyātha.

67798.commentary: (CPa) yato patto'smi viññutan'ti yato paṭṭhāya tāsu tāsu itikattabbatāsu viññutaṃ vijānanabhāvaṃ patto'smi

examples.text: yato sarāmi attānaṃ, yato patto'smi viññutaṃ, n'ābhijānāmi sañcicca, ekapāṇam'pi hiṃsitaṃ.

atīte kururaṭṭhe indapattanagare dhanañcaye rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā anupubbena viññutaṃ patto takkasilāyaṃ sippāni uggahetvā pitarā uparajje patiṭṭhāpito aparabhāge pitu accayena rajjaṃ patvā dasa rājadhamme akopento kurudhamme vattittha. kurudhammo nāma pañcasīlāni, tāni bodhisatto parisuddhāni katvā rakkhi.

67799.meaning1: praised by the wise; commended by the discerning

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, kālāmā, ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vā'ti? akusalā, bhante. sāvajjā vā anavajjā vā'ti? sāvajjā, bhante. viññugarahitā vā viññuppasatthā vā'ti? viññugarahitā, bhante.
